notes:
Passed on the fake backend only (gate exit 0, evidence contract_checked, never an MHS-Device level). No hardware was attached, no hardware backend exists and no hardware or upstream run was made; the package is model-authored and unreviewed (driver.lock.json reviewed_by is null). The card's GymnasiumDriver decision is used as-is (no DEVIATION FROM THE CARD); native is the card's entry class dexart.env.rl_env.base:BaseRLEnv (confirmed at dexart/env/rl_env/base.py:28). The card's other entry symbol dexart.env.create_env:create_env (confirmed at dexart/env/create_env.py:13) is a factory function, not the class G7 checks, so it is cited in the facts but not used as native. One device per package: this package implements the laptop task of the four create_env tasks (create_env.py:32-41); the faucet, bucket and toilet tasks are not implemented.

The upstream clone was never imported or run. The clone needs gym 0.25.2, sapien 2.2.1, numpy, transforms3d and open3d 0.14.1 (setup.py:16-18) plus the separately downloaded asset directory (README.md:35-37), and the gate cannot install or import that stack. The only backend is the package's fake (backends = {fake: .fake:FakeDexArtLaptop}), a pure-Python kinematic stand-in for the BaseRLEnv surface the Gymnasium bridge uses: it implements reset, step, action_space and observation_space, returns the legacy four-value step tuple and the legacy reset observation, and models no Sapien rigid-body dynamics, contacts, friction, inverse kinematics, motors, grasp physics, task reward or early success termination. It was never compared with an upstream run. The state observation has the real laptop layout and length (22 joint positions plus 3+3+3 palm values and 1 progress value = 32, laptop_env.py:71-75); its values are a stand-in. NOT COVERED: the visual observation Dict (camera RGB, depth, segmentation and point-cloud arrays, base.py:601-646) and the early-done task condition.

Fidelity is published as F0 (engine analytic:dexart-laptop) because the only runnable backend is the kinematic fake; the upstream Sapien model would be F1 and the gaps say so. timestep_ms is 40 ms, the control period of one environment step (frame_skip 10 from create_env.py:14 times the 0.004 s physics step from sim_env/laptop_env.py:25; control_time_step at base.py:125); the physics timestep is 4 ms and the gap names both. Determinism is seeded with seed_control parameter for the fake only: the fake seeds Python random.Random from the reset seed and repeats its draw and trajectory for one seed; upstream reset accepts a seed but does not read it (laptop_env.py:104-123) and chooses the articulated-object instance with the global random module (sim_env/laptop_env.py:120-125), so no seed-replay claim is made for upstream.

Risk is R0 (card floor R0; the capabilities are R0 simulation classes and the device is simulated). There is no hardware backend, no physical e-stop and no operator-required limit; the e-stop is the runtime's software latch only. No Limit is declared: the only numeric bounds are the environment's own 22-element Box from -1 to 1 (base.py:597-599), which the Gymnasium bridge derives and enforces before any native call, and the bridge's ticks 1 to 10000; no site-limits.example.json is provided. Only catalogue classes cap.world.step.v1, cap.world.reset.v1 and cap.world.seed.v1 are used, so there are no catalogue_requests.

Warnings from the last gate run (all expected, none failing): G6.NO_NATIVE_CALL for cap.world.seed.v1 (the bridge stores the seed for the next reset and makes no native call); G7.MAYBE_ABSENT for the fake's reset (BaseRLEnv inherits reset from the external gym.Env, which the clone's AST cannot follow, so G7 cannot see it; the bridge calls it on every reset and the tests exercise it); G8.NO_UNIT x4 for the bridge-derived numeric inputs (ticks, reset seed, seed, and the action.values array; the catalogue classes carry no units and the bridge sets them). No G4.REF_VALUE or G4.REF_BINARY warning was raised. gate.digest is the digest line the check printed for this package; check-report.json is regenerated by every gate run and is not part of the package.
